title: What I Learned From a Year of Interviewing a Thai Sex Worker
gist: The author, researching a book, says a year of interviews with a Thai sex worker named Ying overturned his assumption of greed and immorality, revealing few meaningful choices for someone caught between family obligation, economic status and religion.

themes.theme: Choice and constraint in Thailand's sex industry

insights.claim: An author who expected to write about a sex worker's greed and hypocrisy concluded instead that she had very few meaningful choices, constrained by family obligation, economic status and religion.
insights.speaker: Toh Oon Hoe
insights.so_what: Illustrates the economic and social constraints that sustain informal labor markets in Thailand.
